channel.title: Kitchen Line Crew: Pickleball Rules & Tips
channel.description: New pins for the Pickleball Rules & Tips board by Kitchen Line Crew.

item.title: Pickleball Rule: Paddle over the net?
item.description: The ball bounces near the net. You hit it on your side, and your follow-through carries your paddle over the net. What's the call? The answer, rule 13.I.1 and the official rule text are on the page. A new pickleball rules question every week from Kitchen Line Crew.

item.title: Pickleball Rule: Serve clips the net. Let?
item.description: Their serve clips the top of the net, drops over, and lands deep in your service court. What's the call? The answer, rule 7.E and the official rule text are on the page. A new pickleball rules question every week from Kitchen Line Crew.

item.title: Pickleball Rule: Can you stand in the kitchen?
item.description: The ball bounces in the kitchen. You step into the kitchen and hit it after the bounce. What's the call? The answer, rule 11.A and the official rule text are on the page. A new pickleball rules question every week from Kitchen Line Crew.
